hypothesis: The published scope-112 construction may admit a scope-111 DTS by replacing exactly one row while leaving the other six rows fixed after clamping its sole over-limit entry.
rationale: Existing local repair tested only a radius-10 neighborhood for row 0 and existing pool work did not exhaustively enumerate a full compatible replacement. The fixed-six decomposition reduces the question to an exact finite search over every normalized six-mark row with all 15 differences in the complement of the fixed rows.
expected_information_gain: A compatible row is an independently checkable scope-111 witness after reinsertion. Exhausting the finite complement without a row closes the strongest one-row replacement family around the published witness and distinguishes local repair failure from the need for coordinated multi-row change.
method: Clamp the published row with scope 112 to [0,11,58,75,98,111]. For each of the seven possible omitted row indices, retain the other six clamped rows, reject fixed sets that already contain internal or cross-row difference collisions, and exhaustively enumerate increasing normalized six-mark rows with maximum entry <=111. Extend marks in increasing order and accept a partial row only when every new difference is an unused member of the fixed-six complement. Independently validate any completed seven-row assignment with research_tools/verify_dts_independent.py.
metric: fixed-six consistency, exact enumeration nodes, complete compatible replacement rows, stopped status, and independent DTS validity
metric_relation_to_true_objective: A completed replacement accepted by the independent integer verifier is exactly a scope<=111 true-objective witness. A zero-row exhaustive result is finite evidence only for this one-row-replacement family and is not a global impossibility proof.

configuration.baseline_rows: published scope-112 witness with row 0 endpoint clamped from 112 to 111
configuration.enumeration: all increasing normalized six-mark rows under scope 111 compatible with the fixed-six difference complement

compute_budget.memory_intent: constant-size integer masks and depth-six recursion

kill_condition: Stop at the first independently validated replacement, at the declared wall or node budget, or after all consistent fixed-six cases are exhausted. Do not infer global infeasibility from this finite family.

baseline_comparison.expected_relation: strict improvement only if complete and validator-valid

previous_best_comparison.radius10_one_row_search: no compatible row in the tested local neighborhood
previous_best_comparison.expected_relation: global one-row replacement enumeration strictly extends the prior local window

interpretation: Preregistered exact finite decomposition; no execution result is claimed in this record until raw output is recorded.
recommended_next_action: Execute once, validate any returned witness independently, then close or promote only this one-row replacement family according to the finite result.
repetition_justification: This is not a repeat of the radius-10 window: it exhausts the full scope-111 row domain against the fixed-six complement and also checks every possible omitted row index for fixed-set consistency.
